appendDesc.Core Utilities: Also covers JsonProtocol (JSON for scheduler events used by the event log), ListenerBus, the shutdown hook manager and signal handling, Hadoop file system listing, serializable wrappers for Hadoop configuration, the last attempt accumulator and small data structures.

tour.title: Events as JSON: JsonProtocol and ListenerBus
tour.description: ListenerBus is the generic base for posting an event to a list of listeners and catching listener failures. For the event log and the history server, JsonProtocol turns each scheduler event into a JSON line and parses it back, including task metrics, accumulables and failure reasons, so that ReplayListenerBus can rebuild the same events later.
